message:
Presenton Desktop electron-v0.9.8-beta

What's New Since 0.9.5

• Connect and sign in to Presenton Cloud directly from the desktop app
• Choose between Standard and Smart presentation generation modes
• Access cloud-generated presentations from your local dashboard
• Improved onboarding and clearer provider connection status
• More responsive dashboard with quicker access to Settings
• Improved presentation deletion and action menus
• More reliable exports, authentication, and session handling
• Additional interface, localization, and stability fixes

Installation
Download Link: https://presenton.ai/download
Love the app? Star us on GitHub → github.com/presenton/presenton
